audit_item: A11 / callable M1.3 preregistration and bundle reader integrity
finding: The older still-callable M1.3 replay generator used default JSON decoding for bundle, fixture manifest, completion receipt, and frozen registration files. A valid SHA marker fixed the raw bytes but duplicate fields still allowed the runner to interpret an ambiguous bundle or registration using last-key-wins semantics.
change: Added one strict object reader using rles_data.loads_unique_json and routed bundle, archive fixture manifest, COMPLETED receipt, existing preregistration, and frozen preregistration through it. Duplicate keys, invalid UTF-8/JSON/IO, and non-object roots now fail before the runner trusts those inputs. Added synthetic reader regressions.

verification.pytest: M1.3 runner JSON regression + both analyzer suites: 40 passed, 1 skipped (host cannot create symlinks)
verification.ruff: passed for changed runner and test
verification.mypy: packages qa: 224 source files, no issues; installed untyped-wheel diagnostic disabled

replay_boundary: No bundle, real fixture, registry, market, Validation, Test, or Holdout was opened. Since the runner's code SHA changed, a prior frozen registration cannot be replayed with this new runner identity; any future authorized replay requires a fresh registration frozen against the updated source.
